newsitem.title: UK: S&P - full statement on UBS CreditWatch.
newsitem.headline: S&P - full statement on UBS CreditWatch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it placed its AAA long-term ratings of Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) and its units on CreditWatch with negative implications.
This followed an earlier announcement by UBS on Tuesday that said S&P had put its AAA rating on CreditWatch.
Following is the full press release from S&P.
Standard & Poor's today has placed its triple-A' long-term ratings of Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) and its units, on CreditWatch with negative implications. (See list below.)
The short-term ratings of Union Bank of Switzerland and its units are affirmed.

The CreditWatch action follows today's announcement that UBS will record a SFr0.5 billion loss in 1996 as a result of significant provisions reflecting continued asset quality problems in the bank's domestic market. UBS also announced several positive initiatives designed to improve the profitability of its domestic operations. These measures, however, will not make a positive contribution to group earnings until 1997.

Standard & Poor's will meet with management to discuss the outlook for UBS's asset quality, and the likely impact of future provisioning needs on the bank's profitability going forward, in light of the continued difficult operating environment in Switzerland, Standard & Poor's said. -- CreditWire RATINGS
